T-1.title: Rule Review Record

T-2.summary: Evidence attachment, audit trail, finalize gate. Every decision traceable by a third party.

T-5.title: Exportable Verification Output
T-5.summary: One-click PDF + JSON export. Full traceability. What VVBs pay for.
